description: RoboCAD complexity ladder: 30 prompts from trivial primitives to multi-part assemblies. Used by benchmarks/evaluate_complexity.py to baseline the current AI → parametric CAD pipeline.
model_hint: Use the model configured in .env (default qwen3-coder:latest via Ollama).

tiers.name: T1 - Primitive
tiers.description: Single primitive solid with no holes or features.

prompts.prompt: A solid cube 10 mm × 10 mm × 10 mm.
A solid cylinder 20 mm diameter and 10 mm tall.
A solid cone 30 mm base diameter and 40 mm tall.
A solid triangular prism 50 mm long with a 20 mm equilateral triangle cross-section.
A hollow cylinder with 20 mm outer diameter, 16 mm inner diameter, and 10 mm height.
A solid wedge 40 mm wide, 20 mm deep, and 10 mm tall at the thick end tapering to 2 mm.

tiers.name: T2 - Basic part
tiers.description: Single prismatic part with holes or simple additions.

prompts.prompt: A 120 mm × 80 mm × 3 mm rectangular base plate with four M3 mounting holes on a 100 mm × 60 mm grid.
An L-bracket 40 mm tall, 40 mm wide, 30 mm deep, 3 mm thick, with four 4 mm mounting holes on one face.
A simple wheel hub with 30 mm outer diameter, 6 mm bore, 8 mm height, and four M3 bolt holes on a 20 mm PCD.
A 20-tooth GT2 pulley with 2 mm pitch, 5 mm bore, 7 mm total width, and 1 mm belt flanges.
A simple robot arm link 120 mm long, 20 mm wide, 5 mm thick, with a 6 mm hole at each end.
A rectangular electronics enclosure bottom shell 100 mm × 60 mm × 30 mm with 2 mm wall thickness and four M3 mounting bosses in the corners.

tiers.name: T3 - Intermediate
tiers.description: Single part with multiple features, patterns, and fillets.

prompts.prompt: A 150 mm × 100 mm × 3 mm base plate with a 4×3 grid of M3 holes on 30 mm spacing, 3 mm corner fillets, and two raised 5 mm tall NEMA-17 motor mounts near the long edges.
A camera mount with a 40 mm × 30 mm base, 2 mm wall thickness, a 6 mm pivot hole centered, a 20 mm wide strap slot, and two M3 mounting holes.
A rigid shaft coupler 25 mm outer diameter, 30 mm length, 5 mm through-bore, and two perpendicular M3 set-screw holes.
A 40 mm cooling fan shroud with a 32 mm × 32 mm M3 mounting pattern, a 38 mm central airflow hole, and a 5 mm tall duct wall.
A parallel gripper jaw 50 mm × 20 mm × 10 mm with a 45° V-groove on the gripping face, two M2 mounting holes on the back face, and 2 mm edge fillets.
A differential-drive robot chassis base 150 mm × 100 mm × 3 mm with two NEMA-17 motor mount cutouts and a 20 mm caster clearance hole.

tiers.name: T4 - Advanced
tiers.description: Multi-part or highly constrained single parts approaching assembly complexity.

prompts.prompt: A 2-DOF robot arm assembly: a 120 mm upper link and a 100 mm lower link, each with 6 mm bores at both ends, sharing a common 20 mm hinge bracket.
A wheel and hub assembly: a 60 mm diameter 3D-printable wheel with a 6 mm D-shaft bore, attached to a separate hub with four M3 bolt holes on a 40 mm PCD.
A differential-drive robot chassis assembly: a 150 mm × 100 mm base plate, two NEMA-17 motor mounts, two wheel hubs with 6 mm bores, and a caster spacer.
A parallel-jaw gripper assembly: two identical gripper jaws, a pivot pin, a servo horn mount, and a 40 mm wide base bracket.
A simple planetary gearbox carrier: a sun gear spacer 10 mm diameter, three planet pin holes on a 30 mm PCD, and an outer ring bracket 50 mm diameter.
A suspension bracket with a 30 mm wide A-arm shape, 5 mm thick, two 8 mm pivot bores, and a 10 mm ball joint hole at the apex.

tiers.name: T5 - Expert
tiers.description: Full robot subsystem descriptions requiring feature trees, constraints, assemblies, and verification.

prompts.prompt: Design a differential-drive robot chassis assembly: two NEMA-17 motor mounts constrained to a 100 mm wheelbase, a 20 mm caster clearance, a Raspberry Pi 5 mounting plate with four M3 holes, and wheel hubs with 6 mm shaft bores. Ensure all parts are editable parametric features, validate the assembly mates, and run a static load check on the base plate.
Design a 2-DOF robot arm assembly: shoulder NEMA-17, elbow NEMA-17, 200 mm link, belt drive, and base mountable on 2040 aluminum extrusion. Include bracket parts, pulleys, and shaft spacers.
Design a robotic gripper assembly: two parallel jaws driven by a 9g servo, a fixed base, a 6 mm pivot pin, and mounting holes for M3 screws. Ensure the jaws open to at least 40 mm.
Design a mini 3-axis CNC-style gantry cart: a 100 mm × 80 mm base plate, two MGN12 linear rail mount blocks, a stepper motor mount for NEMA-17, and a tool holder bracket.

Design a rocker-bogie suspension mini-module for a rover: a central rocker arm, two bogie arms, four pivot brackets, and eight 6 mm pivot bores. The wheels are out of scope; only the suspension linkage.
Design a Stewart platform base: a triangular base plate with six 8 mm ball-joint mounting holes evenly spaced on a 120 mm pitch circle, 5 mm thick, with 3 mm fillets on all edges.
